blocks.text: Annihilation (dono ka khatam ho jana) pair production ka ulta process hai. Jab electron aur positron milte hain to dono khatam ho kar do gamma ray photons ban jate hain (Fig. 12.2). Reaction:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Fig. 12.4' ka reference deti hai, magar electron aur positron ka annihilation Figure 12.2 mein hai; Fig. 12.4 to teen radioactive radiations wali figure hai.

Har gamma photon ki energy 0.51 MeV hai, jo electron ya positron ki rest mass energy E = m₀c² ke barabar hai. Annihilation mein energy aur momentum conserve rehte hain (isi liye do photons ulti directions mein jate hain). Electron-positron ke ilawa doosre particles aur un ke anti-particles bhi annihilate ho sakte hain, maslan proton aur antiproton, lepton aur antilepton, quark aur antiquark.

blocks.alt: Wavy (lehar jaisa) photon, jis par hν likha hai, seedhe teer ke saath nucleus tak aata hai; nucleus nucleons ka cluster (guchha) dikhaya gaya hai. Nucleus se positron (+e, kinetic energy K₊) oopar aur electron (-e, kinetic energy K₋) neeche nikalta hai; dono photon ke raste ko aage barhati dashed lakeer se angle θ banate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.1: Zyada energy wala photon nucleus ke paas interact kar ke (asar daal kar) electron aur positron ke pair mein badal jata hai (kitab ki Figure 12.1 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).
blocks.long_description: Photon baen se aata hai. Positron oopar wale raste par hara gola aur electron neeche wale raste par grey gola hai; siron ke teeron par K₊ aur K₋ likha hai, aur dono barabar angles θ dashed lakeer se naape gaye hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen se aane wali lehar (wave) gamma photon hai jis ki energy hν hai. Yeh nucleus ke qareeb khatam ho kar do particles banata hai: oopar hara positron (+e) aur neeche electron (−e). K₊ aur K₋ in dono ki kinetic energies hain, aur dono particles photon ke seedhe raste (dashed lakeer) se barabar angle θ par nikalte hain. Nucleus is liye zaroori hai ke woh thora peeche hat kar (recoil) momentum conserve rakhta hai. Photon ki energy kam se kam 1.02 MeV honi chahiye; is se zyada energy K₊ aur K₋ ban jati hai.

blocks.alt: Ek horizontal (leti hui) lakeer par baen taraf electron e⁻ aur daen taraf positron e⁺ hai. Beech mein ek vertical (khari) wavy lakeer usay kaatti hai, aur teer dikhate hain ke ek gamma ray oopar aur doosri neeche jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.2: Electron aur positron ka fusion (milaap) (kitab ki Figure 12.2 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Electron (e⁻) baen se aur positron (e⁺) daen se ek doosre ki taraf aate hain aur beech mein mil kar annihilate (khatam) ho jate hain. Un ki jagah do gamma photons bante hain jo ulti directions mein, ek oopar aur ek neeche, jate hain taa ke momentum conserve rahe. Har gamma photon ki energy 0.51 MeV hai, jo electron ya positron ki rest mass energy ke barabar hai.

CERN mein particles ki bohat zyada energy wali collisions (takkaron) se pata chala hai ke takrane wale particles ka kuch mass Einstein ki equation (E = mc²) ke mutabiq electromagnetic radiation ban jata hai, aur bacha hua mass naye sub-atomic particles ki shakal mein saamne aata hai (Fig. 12.3).

blocks.alt: Kaale background par particles ke raste. Proton p baen se aa kar A par proton (hydrogen nucleus) se takrata hai; shuru ke paas hara chakkar (spiral) atom se nikla electron hai. A se neele raste (negative pions) oopar murte hain aur surkh raste (positive particles p, K⁺, π⁺) daen taraf phailte hain. A se B tak dashed lakeer neutral lambda particle (Λ⁰) ka rasta hai, jo B par p aur π⁻ mein toot jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.3: zyada energy wali pp (proton-proton) collision jis se 18 naye particles bante hain (kitab ki Figure 12.3 ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har lakeer ek particle ka rasta hai. Magnetic field mein negative particles (neele) ek taraf aur positive particles (surkh) doosri taraf murte hain. Neutral lambda (Λ⁰) par charge nahi, is liye us ka rasta nazar nahi aata (dashed); woh B par toot kar do charged particles (p aur π⁻) banata hai. Takrane wale protons ki kuch energy in naye particles ka mass ban gayi.

blocks.caption: Pair production aur annihilation
rows: kam se kam 2m₀c² = 1.02 MeV; zyada energy kinetic ban jati hai

blocks.prompt: Kya 20 keV energy ke photons se pair production ho sakti hai (short question 12.8)? Electron-positron pair ek hi photon mein kyun nahi badal sakta (short question 12.13)?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Electron aur positron banane ke liye kam se kam 2m₀c² = 1.02 MeV chahiye, aur 20 keV is se bohat kam hai. Ek photon momentum ka hisaab poora nahi kar sakta: jis frame mein pair ruka hua ho us ka total momentum zero hai, magar ek photon ka momentum hamesha E/c hota hai (zero nahi), to momentum aur energy dono conserve nahi reh sakte. Ulti directions mein chalte do photons ka total momentum zero ho sakta hai aur woh energy aapas mein baant lete hain.

blocks.prompt: Matter aur antimatter mein kya farq hai (comprehensive question 12.3)? Pair annihilation misal se samjhaiye aur medical (tib) mein is ka use bataiye (comprehensive question 12.4).
blocks.explanation: Farq neeche table mein hai. Jab particle apne antiparticle se milta hai to dono annihilate ho jate hain aur un ka mass energy ban jata hai; electron aur positron ulti directions mein chalte 0.51 MeV ke do gamma photons dete hain. Positron emission tomography (PET) scan mein mareez ko positron nikalne wala tracer diya jata hai; har positron body ke kisi electron se annihilate hota hai, aur mareez ke gird detectors ulti directions wale gamma photons ke pairs pakar kar dikhate hain ke tracer kahan jama hua.

rows: Wahi mass, magar charge ulta: positron +e, antiproton −e
Hamari duniya isi se bani hai
Bohat kam milta hai (cosmic rays, accelerators, radioactive decay)

items: Dirac (1928): har particle ka anti-particle, wahi rest mass, ulta charge; positron e⁺ Anderson ne 1932 mein dekha; antiproton Segre aur Chamberlain ne 1955 mein. Accelerators, cosmic rays aur fission bohat se particles banate hain.

Pair production: nucleus ke qareeb kam se kam 1.02 MeV ka gamma photon → e⁻ + e⁺. Annihilation: e⁻ + e⁺ → γ + γ, har photon 0.51 MeV; charge, momentum, energy conserve. CERN: kuch mass radiation, baqi naye particles.
